title: Fixed Admin host-local inspection, Production readiness, and Recovery Survival Plane

phases.objective: Expose a fixed Admin-only recovery_kernel_call dispatcher for exact-SHA Hostinger role-local full inspection and a bounded read-only Production activation readiness probe, without accepting credentials, migration, provider, workflow, SQL, shell, or mutation controls.

e2e_journeys.actor: Production Admin GPT through fixed system dispatcher
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The fixed dispatcher invokes the existing host-local adapter directly after admin authorization, exact identity binding, and request allowlist validation; it returns bounded read-only evidence with migration omitted and all mutation flags false.
steps: Submit recovery_kernel_call with capability_key=production_host_local_database_inspect and only expected_sha plus optional target_key=production-runtime inside bounded input.
Authorize the fixed tool for an admin/service principal before adapter invocation.
Bind the running Production repository, branch, and exact SHA before any database connection.
Read the three independent Hostinger role identities from the Hostinger process environment.
Run database.full_inspection in dry_run mode and return sanitized evidence without GitHub dispatch, migration, grant, SQL, shell, or workflow execution.
assertions: non-admin principals are rejected before adapter invocation
the request schema accepts only expected_sha and target_key
identity mismatch fails closed before database connection
host_local_role_env is unavailable to Staging, and the fixed capability never accepts it or any other credential/source field from the caller
database.inspect/database.full_inspection is dry_run-only and migration_selected=false
database_mutation_performed, migration_apply_performed, grant_mutation_performed, and workflow_dispatch_performed are false
the fixed tool does not route through the generic endpoint facade

e2e_journeys.actor: Production Admin GPT through fixed system dispatcher
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The dispatcher returns the bounded readiness contract for MCP catalog schema, governance DB privilege, and runtime persistence without loading the oversized catalog and without performing writes.
steps: Submit recovery_kernel_call with capability_key=production_activation_readiness_probe and an empty bounded input object as an admin/service principal.
Run the three existing readiness readers in read-only mode.
Return checks, bounded dimension status, mutation attestation, and sanitized error codes.
Reject non-empty arguments or non-admin principals before readiness readers execute.
assertions: readiness probe accepts no arguments
the probe is admin-only
the result contains no secrets and reports mutation flags explicitly
the probe does not enumerate or depend on the oversized dynamic catalog response

phases.objective: Provide a repository-owned, Production-only Recovery/Survival Plane that remains callable without the DB-backed MCP catalog, binds Root of Trust to the exact runtime SHA, manifest hash, role target fingerprints, and verified admin principal, emits hash-only runtime attestation and causal/proof-carrying plans, separates Staging, and fails closed before any consequential step unless durable append-only evidence, approval, locking, idempotency, executor, and readback authorities are injected. Production reconstruction uses the existing Admin governed execution path through auth.mad4b.com and does not require a Windows/local connector. Unsupported SSH/SQL are contract-only, role-separated, hash-bound, deny-by-default escape-hatch references; Local Connector remains explicitly deferred and is never a Production fallback.

e2e_journeys.actor: Production Admin GPT through private fixed Recovery Kernel surface
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The bounded Production-only surface returns static capability discovery, Root of Trust and hash-only runtime attestation, targeted readiness, host-local database.full_inspection dry-run, causal sanitized findings, proof-carrying deterministic plan/preview, approval challenge, explicit append-only recovery state, and durable evidence references without requiring the oversized dynamic catalog; consequential execution remains fail-closed until separate injected authorities exist. Unsupported SSH/SQL provide only audited previews and ephemeral hash references; no live session or command/SQL execution is implemented.
steps: Use the private Production schema rather than shared Admin Core or Staging schemas.

Read recovery_capabilities, production_identity, recovery_manifest_get, recovery_trust_model, runtime_attestation, tool_surface_parity, and production_activation_readiness without catalog enumeration.

Run database_full_inspection only with expected_sha and server-default target_key=production-runtime; the adapter binds database.inspect/database.full_inspection/dry_run and host_local_role_env internally.

Register bounded sanitized findings and causal graph, then create a proof-carrying plan containing finding IDs, exact SHA, manifest/attestation hashes, role target fingerprints, preconditions, postconditions, rollback classification, and no execution authorization.

Create a single-use plan/step approval challenge, transition through the named Recovery state machine with append-only evidence, then require verified admin principal, fresh trust/target checks, durable approval verifier, lock provider, idempotency state, mutation executor, and same-cycle readback before any consequential step.

Read run/evidence state through bounded sanitized readback with explicit degraded-memory versus durable-store status and no raw logs, credentials, connection strings, database identifiers, or secrets.

For an unsupported gap, open a recorded escalation or preview S0-S5/Q0-Q6 contract using only incident IDs, profiles, hashes, scope references, and expiry; execution remains kill-switched and requires an injected managed broker plus separate approval.

Model E0-E6 exception lifecycle as immutable, durable-store-backed create/approve/activate/heartbeat/consume/revoke/expire transitions; E6 requires two distinct principal fingerprints and no transition creates provider authority by itself.

Preview disaster-recovery backup, restore, replacement, validation, cutover, rollback, and post-cutover credential-rotation phases without connecting to a provider, copying data, changing credentials, or mutating runtime.
assertions: private Recovery operations and Production-only capability keys are absent from Staging schemas; the shared Admin Core exposes only the generic recovery_kernel_call name, with runtime capability isolation
all Recovery Kernel input contracts reject raw SQL, shell, credentials, database identifiers, migration/grant selection, workflow/ref, and arbitrary target-source controls
exact Production repository, branch, and SHA identity is checked before host-local inspection
inspection and readiness paths report explicit read-only and mutation attestations
plan and step hashes include the exact SHA and target fingerprint
approval challenge never returns an approval token
runtime attestation exposes hashes/presence flags only and never raw credentials
manifest, exact SHA, role target fingerprint, and verified admin principal are independently required for mutation
the Recovery state machine accepts only declared transitions and append-only evidence
durable recovery store and durable idempotency are required before consequential execution
consequential recovery requires an injected durable store explicitly independent of all target role databases and provider access

empty database reconstruction is repository-contract-only and selects only roles proven EMPTY_UNINITIALIZED_DATABASE by a same-cycle full inspection across tables/views/triggers/routines/events; a nonempty role is preserved

Production reconstruction is authorized through the existing Admin governed execution path at auth.mad4b.com; Local Connector availability is not a prerequisite and its deferred/unavailable state cannot reroute or block the Production path

selected-role reconstruction is bound to a closed role enum, durable inspection_run_id, finding/evidence IDs and hashes, exact role object-count fingerprints, target composite fingerprint, exact source SHA, and plan hash

selected role rebuild re-reads zero-object evidence immediately before each role bundle, executes roles sequentially, requires same-cycle postconditions/behavioral verification, and stops before the next role after verification failure
runtime remains untouched when governance and/or runtime_persistence are selected, and governance nonempty is never touched by a persistence-only selection

empty database reconstruction enters through one ordered graph: durable full-inspection record, selected-role zero-object recheck, role bundle baseline, role-specific seeds, same-cycle role postconditions, stop-or-next-role, separate grants approval, and behavioral probes
standalone migration-first execution on an empty target is denied before mutation and grants remain separately approved
unsupported SSH/SQL contracts reject raw command, SQL, credentials, host, database, and local connector fields
unsupported capability execution is denied without the kill-switch, injected broker, and separate approval
privileged exception contracts remain scoped resources with bounded TTL, max uses, budget, and dual-control metadata
exception lifecycle transitions are append-only and require injected durable exception storage; missing storage is preview-only or fail-closed rather than memory-authorized
E6 exception activation requires two distinct approved principal fingerprints and cannot be self-approved by the requesting principal
disaster-recovery preview includes backup/restore/replacement/cutover/rollback phases, but provider_connected, execution_allowed, and runtime_mutation_performed remain false
exception revocation, emergency approval, audit-store fallback, and response/session degradation remain explicit contracts rather than bypasses
consequential execution fails closed without durable approval, lock, executor, and readback authorities
unknown executor outcomes are recorded as failed_closed and are never replayed automatically
all evidence is sanitized and secrets_included=false
Staging Windows/Docker remains separately scoped; Local Connector is deferred to an optional diagnostic follow-up and cannot provide Production authority
